concept: An AI-guided reference for the Japanese personal seal (hanko/inkan) tradition: describe your name or purpose (bank account, real estate contract, art signature) and the app explains which seal type (jitsuin, ginkoin, mitomein) and script style fits, plus real registration etiquette.

Describe an event or place (a festival, a restaurant entrance, a family crest) and Claude AI matches it to the real chochin paper-lantern tradition it belongs to, explaining shape, regional style, and the calligraphy conventions painted on them.

Describe a wish for your shop, home, or venture and Claude AI matches it to the real maneki-neko (beckoning cat) tradition - which paw, which color, which pose - explaining the Edo-era folklore and shopkeeper etiquette behind each variant.
